title: Assistant agentic model client interface and OpenAI adapter

criteria.statement: internal/adapters/llm defines an AgentModelClient Next(ctx, req, onEvent) seam with provider-neutral request, response, tool schema, tool_choice, stop_reason, and progress-event types.

The cross-provider model request/response datamodel serializes to the item 1 domain types for AssistantAgentMessage, AssistantAgentContentBlock, AssistantAgentToolCall, and AssistantToolObservation; tool results thread back with one role=tool message per tool_call_id and multi-call assistant turns stay grouped in one assistant message.
The OpenAI-compatible adapter posts /v1/chat/completions requests with native tools/tool_choice fields and parses choices[].message.tool_calls into domain.AssistantAgentToolCall values.
The OpenAI-compatible adapter preserves the legacy ContextTooLargeError classification pattern for HTTP and provider error responses.
The Anthropic agent client compiles behind the same AgentModelClient seam and returns a typed deferred-provider error until item 12 implements /v1/messages tool_use/tool_result support.
